2608.13730.title: Building AI-Intensive Software with AI: Early Results and a Cautionary Tale on Measuring Development Cost
2608.13730.paper_summary: Empirical reports on the true cost of AI-intensive software development remain scarce, and the few that exist are easy to get wrong in ways that never surface in the final number. We report early results from an ongoing case study: a six-person student team built a full conversational onboarding assistant -- RAG-based code chat, guided tours, dependency graphs, technical-debt analysis -- over one academic term using pervasive AI assistance. We instrumented development with a three-layer cost model (real AI spend, self-reported human effort, human counterfactual) and initially reported a 19.4x cost ratio. A follow-up pass revealed two independent errors -- inferring per-token cost under a flat-rate subscription, and pricing the counterfactual with the wrong regional labor rates -- that together had inflated the ratio by roughly 2x; the corrected figure is ~9.9x. We present this correction as an early, generalizable finding in its own right: both errors are easy to make, invisible in the final number, and plausibly common in similar reports. We outline next steps toward a more robust, replicable costing methodology for AI-intensive development.
2608.13730.paper_summary_zh: 實證報告關於 AI 密集型軟體開發的真實成本仍然稀少，而現有的幾個報告很容易以未在最終數字中顯現的方式出錯。我們報告了一項正在進行的案例研究的早期結果：一個六人學生團隊在一個學期內使用普遍的 AI 協助構建了一個完整的對話式入職助手 -- 基於 RAG 的代碼聊天、導覽、依賴圖、技術負債分析。我們使用三層成本模型（實際 AI 開支、自報人力成本、人類反事實）對開發進行了儀器化，最初報告的成本比率為 19.4 倍。後續檢查揭示了兩個獨立的錯誤 -- 在固定費率訂閱下推斷每個令牌的成本，以及用錯誤的區域勞動力費率為反事實定價 -- 這兩者共同將比率膨脹了大約 2 倍；修正後的數字約為 9.9 倍。我們將這一修正作為一個早期的、可推廣的發現來呈現：這兩個錯誤都很容易發生，在最終數字中不可見，並且在類似報告中 plausibly 常見。我們概述了邁向更穩健、可重複的 AI 密集型開發成本方法論的下一步。
